source_clause: R1HVS3.) Heated/vented seat, heated wheel, and seat zone popup is displayed on first press of heated/vented seat, heated wheel, or seat zone control. The first press will open popup and change level of heated/vented seat, wheel, or seat zone. The popup will be displayed for 3 seconds. If an item in the popup is selected the timer will restart. Additional presses of the heated/vented seat, heated wheel, or seat zone icon will change the level of heated/vented seat, heated wheel, or seat zone area.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.10（R1HVS3）以三句定出 comfort popup 之出現時機、3 秒之顯示與其重計，以及後續按壓之行為，三個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：第十六軸之正向值（17.3）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補，第十二軸亦補。為什麼這樣切：`064-02` 之兩個斷言（3 秒關閉、選取後重計）為同一 leaf 之兩面，故合為一條而以三步涵蓋（§8.2 單位歸 037）。刻意略過：**popup 之內容與版面不驗** —— 本節只定其時機與時長（**DR #11**）；**3 秒為條文明值**，故 ER 寫入該值而不寫「短暫」（R-C22 之反面：有值即用值）。

tcs.tc_title: The first press opens the popup and changes the level
tcs.test_item:
The first press will open popup and change level of heated/vented seat, wheel, or seat zone.

(The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel; The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle; read the screen and the heated seat level)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel (17.3)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the heated seat control for the first time
2. Read the screen and the heated seat level
tcs.expected_result:
1. The popup is displayed
2. The heated seat level has changed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.test_item_authored: The system shall display the heated/vented seat, heated wheel and seat zone popup on the first press of that control and change the level on that press

tcs.tc_title: The popup lasts three seconds and its timer restarts on selection
tcs.test_item:
If an item in the popup is selected the timer will restart.

(The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel; The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle; display the popup again and select an item in it)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel (17.3)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the heated seat control so that the popup is displayed
2. Wait without touching the popup
3. Display the popup again and select an item in it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The popup is displayed
2. The popup closes after 3 seconds
3. The popup remains displayed for a further 3 seconds from the selection
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
